headline: RJD Workers Protest Following PM Modi's Nitish Setu Inauguration
seoTitle: PM Modi Inaugurates Nitish Setu Bridge
metaDescription: Following the inauguration of Nitish Setu by PM Modi in Bihar, RJD workers were reported tearing down NDA banners and protesting over invitation issues.
aiSummaryBullets: Members of the Rashtriya Janata Dal removed BJP banners and posters from the newly inaugurated Nitish Setu bridge.
The demonstration followed reports that local leaders were not invited to the event organized by the central and state governments.
Political controversy continues in Bihar regarding the credit for the infrastructure project and the exclusion of certain opposition members.
aiContextParagraph: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently inaugurated the Nitish Setu, a significant infrastructure project located in the Vaishali district of Bihar. The bridge, named after Chief Minister Nitish Kumar, has become the center of a political dispute between the Bharatiya Janata Party-led alliance and the Rashtriya Janata Dal. Following the inauguration ceremony, local RJD workers were documented in viral videos removing NDA-related posters and banners from the site. Tensions were further exacerbated by claims from residents and party members that the former deputy chief minister of the state did not receive an invitation to the event, despite the project's foundation having been laid during his tenure in government. This disagreement over credit and protocol has sparked widespread debate across regional and national media, highlighting ongoing political frictions within the state’s governance framework.
whyItIsViral: The event is trending due to significant coverage across four independent national outlets and rapid, contentious public reactions caught on video.
